sentences.en: The fire brigade arrived to find the house well alight.
sentences.zh: 消防队赶到时发现房子已经烧起来了。

sentences.en: This train terminates here. Please alight from the train.
sentences.zh: 这趟火车在这里终点站停车。请下车。
